senses.gloss: m.(b. h. מַשּׂוֹר; נָסַר)a tool with rough edges or teeth, file, saw.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 17:4">Sabb. XVII, 4</cite> <he>מ׳ הגדול</he> saw for cutting wood.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 21:3">Kel. XXI, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 1:8">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. I, 8</cite> <he>מלבן של מ׳ הגדול</he> the frame of the saw.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sukkah 3:3:2">Y. Succ. III, 53ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>כמין מ׳</he> leaves serrated like a saw, v. <cite ref="M00179"><he>מַגָּל</he></cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 2:7">Tosef. Succ. II, 7</cite>; Bab.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 6">Gen. R. s. 6</cite>; Midr. Sam. ch. IX, v. <cite ref="N00960"><he>נָסַר</he></cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:13">Ex. R. s. 5</cite> <he>כס׳</he> (Var. <he>כמַסְמָר</he>); a. e.
